text: 第九届虹桥国际经济论坛分论坛——《2026年世界贸易报告》研讨暨中文版发布会11月6日举行，《2026年世界贸易报告》中文版在现场发布。中国世界贸易组织研究会会长马建春在主旨演讲中提到，《报告》通过严谨的模拟测算提供了极其严肃的预警：若不加干预，任由贸易体系走向碎片化，到2050年全球将面临巨大的机会成本——失去的潜在经济增量相当于全球实际GDP的5%到10%。历史已证明，规则一旦被破坏，重建的成本极其高昂。全世界需要的是修补和升级以WTO为核心的多边框架。
text_en: The ninth Hongqiao International Economic Forum sub-forum—the Seminar on the World Trade Report 2026 and Chinese Edition Release—was held on November 6, and the Chinese edition of the World Trade Report 2026 was released on site. Ma Jianchun, president of the China Society for WTO Studies, said in his keynote speech that the report provides an extremely serious warning through rigorous simulation estimates: if left unchecked and the trading system is allowed to fragment, by 2050 the world will face enormous opportunity costs—lost potential economic gains equivalent to 5% to 10% of global real GDP. History has proven that once rules are broken, the cost of rebuilding them is extremely high. What the world needs is to repair and upgrade the multilateral framework centered on the WTO.
